name: resilience
description: Runtime quality: does it stay up, can you see it, is it fast. One resilience skill whose six references load only as a change touches them: failure-mode design at integration points (timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaking, degradation), error handling, concurrency, event-driven messaging (brokers, outbox, sagas, DLQ), observability (structured logs with correlation IDs, RED/USE metrics, traces, honest health checks) and measure-first performance (N+1, payload, bundle, Core Web Vitals, cache correctness). One audit, /resilience:review, over all six rubrics or one via --concern, and two workers, observability-engineer and performance-engineer, that apply only what a finding proves.
